title: Closed-Loop Narrative Market Framework (CL-NMF): An Agent-Based Model of Opinion Dynamics for Studying Narrative Economics
content: This paper models how narratives, represented as opinions, influence investment behaviour, where investors are represented as agents and their behaviour is encoded through the prices they quote in the market. Motivated by Nobel laureate Robert Shiller’s theory of Narrative Economics, I develop a novel agent-based modeling framework that integrates continuous-time nonlinear opinion dynamics with zero-intelligence automated traders in an adaptive, co-evolutionary financial market. The proposed framework enables investors’ opinions to evolve through social influence, external information, and market feedback, providing a computational approach for studying the co-evolution of narratives and market dynamics. The framework is evaluated through a series of computational experiments that demonstrate its ability to reproduce key market behaviours predicted by Shiller’s Narrative Economics.
